{{Quote|The Quarren Isolation League is no more, and the exploitation of our people will end now. The new government of Mon Calamari will more properly reflect the will of our planet, not the will of the guilds that grew rich from our work.|Tundra Dowmeia addresses a Quarren audience|<ref name="Insider73">{{InsiderCite|73|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:01:13}}</ref>}}
'''Tundra Dowmeia''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Dowmeia succeeded fellow Quarren [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]] as Mon Calamari's [[Senator/Legends|senator]] to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]] after Tikkes was censured for his connections to a [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] ring. Dowmeia represented a different faction of more progressive Quarren, and the new senator became a [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|broke out]], it was revealed that Tikkes and his [[Quarren Isolation League/Legends|Quarren Isolation League]] had allied with the breakaway [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|civil war]] came to Mon Calamari. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] won the battle, and peace was brokered between the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and Quarren [[Species/Legends|races]] a [[21 BBY/Legends|year later]]. Dowmeia signed the peace accords but drew criticism from many of his fellow Quarren, who saw their senator as a Republic and Mon Calamari pawn.

As a result of the peace agreement, Mon Calamari was jointly represented by a Quarren and a Mon Calamari in the Republic Senate. Dowmeia and [[Meena Tills/Legends|Meena Tills]] fulfilled this obligation until the end of the Clone Wars, though they were faced with many Separatist [[Spy/Legends|spies]] in their midst. Both senators gradually became weary of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] increasing wartime executive powers, prompting them to sign the [[Petition of 2000]] near the climax of the war. They joined with like-minded senators in the [[Delegation of 2000]], but their membership in the organization marked them as [[Politics/Legends|political]] enemies to the Supreme Chancellor. Palpatine's executive powers only increased with [[Time/Legends|time]], and in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he reorganized the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with himself as its [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. Dowmeia was arrested by Imperial agents before Palpatine's [[Declaration of a New Order]] to the Senate even concluded.

==Biography==
===Becoming senator===
{{Quote|Arkanis sector goes without milk and bread for two months, and it's the price of being in a remote region. Commenorans can't get their volcho sprig garnishes, and it's a calamity.|Senator Dowmeia, responding to a food shortage "catastrophe" on Commenor|<ref name="HNN54">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|regional/1352_2.html|Hunger Pangs Start to Hit The Colonies}}</ref>}}
[[File:Dac-AORCR.png|thumb|right|250px|Tundra Dowmeia hailed from Dac (pictured) and eventually represented it in the Galactic Senate.]]
A native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], the [[Gender/Legends|male]] Tundra Dowmeia belonged to a faction of progressive [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he succeeded fellow Quarren [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]] as the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of Mon Calamari in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] when the latter was censured after being tied to a [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] ring operating in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="DB" /> After Tikkes escaped from house arrest on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Dowmeia issued a statement saying that the Quarren government on Mon Calamari would assist the Republic in bringing the fugitive Tikkes to justice. The [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo Town District edition]] of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] reported on Dowmeia's statements on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 13:4:11.<ref name="HNN51">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_7.html|Senator Tikkes Jumps Bail}}</ref>

Some [[Time/Legends|time]] later, Dowmeia commented on the planet [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor's]] shortage of fresh comestibles, noting that people seemed to care more about one planet's lack of [[volcho sprig garnish]]es than the two-[[Standard month/Legends|month]]-long lack of essentials like [[Bread/Legends|bread]] and [[Milk/Legends|milk]] in the Outer Rim's [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]]. HoloNet News again reported on Dowmeia on the date 13:5:2.<ref name="HNN54" />

===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Dowmeia is a tool of the Republic and the Cals. He's going to sell out our mines to the Mon Cals and open our seas to who-knows-what. Mark my words: Before long, these seas will be bloodied again.|Ruke Chowall criticizes Dowmeia and the peace accords on Mon Calamari|<ref name="Insider73" />}}
During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Dowmeia was a [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]], remaining close to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|office]].<ref name="DB" /> When news reached Coruscant that [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] breakaway [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was preparing for war against the Republic, Palpatine was granted emergency powers by the Senate; Dowmeia,<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> with [[Aide/Legends|aides]] [[Zil Topur/Legends|Zil Topur]] and [[Nor Wedd]],<ref name="QDB">{{DB|species|quarren|Quarren}}</ref> applauded the move from his [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorpod]] within the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]]. The [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted shortly thereafter when the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Confederate droid army]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|engaged]] the Republic's [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]] in open warfare on the Outer Rim world of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="AOTC" />

As the war progressed, it was revealed that former Senator Tikkes had allied with the Confederacy and pledged Mon Calamari's resources to Dooku's war machine. Since Tikkes lacked the authority to do so, and the progressive Dowmeia held Mon Calamari's Senate seat, civil war erupted on Mon Calamari. Tikkes formed the [[Quarren Isolation League/Legends|Quarren Isolation League]], but it was soon [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|defeated]] by a combined Republic&ndash;[[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] force.<ref name="QILDB">{{DB|organization|qil|Quarren Isolation League}}</ref> Engagements in the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]] continued nonetheless; on one occasion, one or more Separatist [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] stole documents and other data from the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]]. Dowmeia assisted Republic forces in improving Mon Calamari defenses and capturing those responsible for the data theft.<ref name="Insider72">{{InsiderCite|72|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:01:03}}</ref>

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the end of the civil war, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] arrived at the Quarren [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Morjanssik]] on Mon Calamari to oversee the authorization of peace accords between both [[Species/Legends|species]]. Dowmeia signed the accords in his own ink, a move he had intended to signify the importance of the document.<ref name="Insider73" /> The Mon Calamari&ndash;Quarren peace accords established a new precedent of joint Senate representation for both species. Fulfilling this obligation, the Mon Calamari [[Meena Tills/Legends|Meena Tills]] joined Dowmeia in the Senate chamber. Their administration ultimately lasted until the end of the conflict. During the duration of the war, however, both senators were faced with many Separatist [[Spy/Legends|spies]] who had infiltrated their delegation.<ref name="TillsDB">{{DB|character|meenatills|Tills, Meena}}</ref>

Following his signing of the accords, Dowmeia proceeded to address a largely Quarren audience, declaring that the new [[Mon Calamari Council]] would work to the benefit of the entire planet and not the special-interest guilds that had dominated affairs in the past. Although the Mon Calamari population was supportive of the accords, the Quarren believed it to be damaging to Dowmeia's career. Quarren [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Ruke Chowall]] of the counter-cultural newsnet ''[[Bends]]'' accused Dowmeia of being a Republic and Mon Calamari pawn, selling out Quarren [[Mining/Legends|mines]] to the Mon Calamari and only stalling further [[Blood/Legends|bloodshed]] between both species.<ref name="Insider73" />

===Rise of the Empire===
{{Quote|Fang Zar has already been arrested, and Tundra Dowmeia, and it won't be long until the entire Delegation of the Two Thousand are declared enemies of the state.|Senator Padmé Amidala|<ref name="ROTS novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>}}
[[File:PalpatineWelcomingCommittee-ROTS.png|thumb|right|350px|Anjuo and Dowmeia greeted Palpatine.]]
By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NECRotS">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Dowmeia was being assisted in the Senate by [[Cellheim Anujo/Legends|Cellheim Anujo]].<ref name="LD">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/explore/sithsnap/2005/10/sithsnap20051010.html|text=''Sith'' Snapshots: Sith Snapshots: Loyal Delegates}}</ref> That same year,<ref name="NECRotS" /> the Separatists launched an [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|assault]] on Coruscant. In the ensuing battle, the Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] captured the Supreme Chancellor, only for [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to rescue Palpatine. Dowmeia and Tills were two of many senators who greeted Palpatine, accompanied by Skywalker, upon his return to the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] following his brief Separatist captivity.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Dowmeia insisted that Skywalker pay a visit to his [[Tundra Dowmeia's estate|family's estate]], located deep within the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of Mon Calamari. Skywalker, who was preoccupied with thoughts of his [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|wife]], had to break free of Dowmeia's grip and the mass of senators to find her.<ref name="ROTS novel" />

Shortly thereafter, Dowmeia was present at Coruscant's [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]], in the company of a [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], during the [[Mon Calamari Ballet]]'s performance<ref name="SWCE">{{CSWECite|II|326|Mon Calamari Ballet}}</ref> of the [[Squid Lake/Legends|''Squid Lake'']] opera. While he walked hand-in-hand with the Twi'lek, Skywalker ran past them to meet with Palpatine.<ref name="ROTS" />

[[File:RyyderOpera-ROTS.png|thumb|left|345x345px|Dowmeia was present at the Galaxies Opera House.]]
Both Dowmeia and Tills became concerned with Palpatine's increasing executive war powers, prompting them to sign a [[Petition of 2000|Senatorial petition]] calling for a peaceful resolution to the crisis, and join with other signatories in the [[Delegation of 2000]]. Dowmeia's signing of the document marked him as a [[Politics/Legends|political]] enemy to Palpatine.<ref name="Insider85">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref> As such, when Palpatine reorganized the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Dowmeia was arrested, being taken into custody even before the new [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] could finish his [[Declaration of a New Order]].<ref name="ROTS novel" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Let not his activities color perceptions of innocence or guilt in his pending trial. Of fleeing Coruscant, though, our cousin is unmistakably guilty, and the Quarren government of Mon Calamari will assist the Republic by whatever means necessary.|Dowmeia, following Tikkes's escape|<ref name="HNN51" />}}
[[File:TundraDowmeiaCellheimAnujo-SWBC66.png|thumb|right|300px|Dowmeia with his aide, Cellheim Anujo.]]
Possessing a clammy grip<ref name="ROTS novel" /> and having a resonating baritone voice,<ref name="Insider73" /> Tundra Dowmeia was representative of a progressive,<ref name="QILDB" /> Loyalist faction of Quarren who supported the Republic,<ref name="DB" /> as opposed to the members of former Senator Tikkes's Quarren Isolation League.<ref name="QILDB" /> Dowmeia put his loyalty to the Republic above loyalty to his own species, openly stating that the Quarren government on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] would assist in finding Tikkes following the censured senator's escape from house arrest.<ref name="HNN51" />

Dowmeia criticized Commenor [[First Minister (Commenor)|First Minister]] [[Tomlin Gorastor]]'s reaction to a "catastrophic" shortage of fresh comestibles on Commenor, knowing that entire Outer Rim [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] often went without basic food supplies for months.<ref name="HNN54" /> Following the signing of Mon Calamari&ndash;Quarren peace accords, Dowmeia displayed a commitment to improving relations between his homeworld's two dominant species, though his fellow Quarren accused him of being a Republic pawn.<ref name="Insider73" />

Concern over Supreme Chancellor Palpatine's increasing wartime executive powers prompted Dowmeia to sign the Petition of 2000, joining with a larger group of Loyalist senators in the process. This move branded him as one of the Chancellor's enemies in the Senate.<ref name="Insider85" /> As Palpatine was reorganizing the Republic into his own Empire, Dowmeia was one of the first senators to be arrested by agents of the new Imperial government.<ref name="ROTS novel" />

In Quarren culture, Dowmeia's first name meant "bold," while his surname was an archaic term for "speaker for the clutch."<ref name="GCC">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> He had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and orange skin.<ref name="DB" />

==Equipment==
While in the Senate Building applauding Palpatine's emergency powers, Dowmeia wore a red and black-colored cloak.<ref name="AOTC" /> When greeting Palpatine after the Battle of Coruscant, Dowmeia wore a grey dress with a dark-grey collar and a red-colored [[Cape/Legends|cape]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tundra Dowmeia was first mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 51|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #51'']], published online as part of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]]<ref name="HNN51" /> on [[April 11]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN51 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6401165|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=MattPeriolat|date=2002-04-11|time=6:19 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]] wrote the site content.<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> The character was first pictured and connected to<ref name="Scrapbook">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Scrapbook]]''</ref> the then upcoming [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> on [[April 23]], 2002,<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=eu/news/2002/04/news20020426.html|text=Episode II Books from Random House}}</ref> with the release of the reference book [[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Scrapbook|''Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Scrapbook'']], written by [[Ryder Windham]].<ref name="Scrapbook2">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Scrapbook]]''</ref> Episode II, in which Dowmeia made his first appearance,<ref name="AOTC" /> later released on [[May 16]], 2002.<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref>

For [[2005]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> call-sheets, creature tests, and costume fittings referred to Dowmeia as "Tikkes" because the characters shared the same mask.<ref name="Gathering">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/episode-iii/bts/setdiary/news20030908.html|series=Episode III Set Diary|text=Separatist Gathering}}</ref> Dowmeia was portrayed by [[Jeremy Prestoe]],<ref name="LD" /> as well as [[Adam J. Smith]].<ref name="AdamJSmithConGuests">{{YouTube|video=meLBwylH7wg|text=Adam J Smith Tundra Dowmeia Episode III|channel=@ConGuests|name=ConGuests|quote=Adam J Smith played Tundra Dowmeia on Star Wars Episode III at Shepperton Studios. He shares some moments with us on what his filming experience was like as an Alien and with George Lucas.}}</ref> In ''Attack of the Clones'', both Dowmeia and Tikkes wore the same costume, leading to a case of mistaken identities between the two Quarren. The same situation occurred in ''Revenge of the Sith'', albeit with a different outfit.<ref name="MI">{{Blog|holocron|29|Mistaken Identities}}</ref>
